definitions.gloss: fully loaded, packed full, brimming with
definitions.explanation: Loaded to full capacity with cargo or goods. Also used figuratively to mean packed with content, features, or information.

examples.japanese: トラックに{荷物|にもつ}を{満載|まんさい}した。
examples.english: The truck was fully loaded with cargo.

examples.japanese: この{雑誌|ざっし}は{役|やく}に{立|た}つ{情報|じょうほう}{満載|まんさい}だ。
examples.english: This magazine is packed with useful information.

examples.japanese: お{楽|たの}しみ{満載|まんさい}のイベントが{今週末|こんしゅうまつ}に{開催|かいさい}される。
examples.english: An event packed with fun activities will be held this weekend.

notes:
USAGE:
The literal meaning (fully loaded with physical cargo) and the figurative meaning (packed with content) are both very common. The figurative usage is especially frequent in advertising and promotional writing: {情報|じょうほう}{満載|まんさい} (packed with information), {特典|とくてん}{満載|まんさい} (loaded with perks).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {情報|じょうほう}{満載|まんさい}: packed with information
- {荷物|にもつ}を{満載|まんさい}する: to load to full capacity
- お{楽|たの}しみ{満載|まんさい}: packed with fun
- {魅力|みりょく}{満載|まんさい}: full of charm/appeal
